title: Ikan Laga Bilik Sewa
genre: Malay lo-fi hip-hop (chill beat with sung hook)
subject: a young man in a rented room in Shah Alam who changes his one betta fish's water every Sunday night and talks to it about his week
caption: Malay lo-fi hip-hop with a sung hook. Dusty boom-bap drum loop with a lazy swing, warm detuned electric piano chords, a mellow jazz guitar line, round sub bass. Vinyl crackle and soft low-pass haze, close dry vocal. Male light baritone, half-sung murmured delivery. 78 BPM, E minor. Quiet, drowsy and fond. No autotune, no trap hi-hat rolls, no EDM drop, no big chorus stack, no pop ballad strings.
lyrics:
[Intro - electric piano and vinyl crackle, drums enter]

[Verse 1]
Malam Ahad, baldi kecil
Air paip saya biar semalam
Ikan laga merah kat meja
Namanya Pak Lebai

[Pre-Chorus]
Dia kembang sirip
Bila saya balik lewat

[Chorus]
Pak Lebai, minggu ni penat
Bos marah, nasi lemak habis
Kau dengar je, tak menyampuk
Bilik sewa ni, kita berdua

[Verse 2]
Saya tukar air perlahan
Cawan plastik, tangan sejuk
Kawan kata, ikan tak faham
Tapi dia ikut jari saya

[Chorus]
Pak Lebai, minggu ni okey
Gaji masuk, saya beli pelet
Kau dengar je, tak menyampuk
Bilik sewa ni, kita berdua

[Outro - guitar and electric piano fade]
